title: What the Tremere war cost the Order
summary: A Hermetic reading of the Order's decline.

claims.text: A century of war against the renegade House Tremere drained Hermetic Quintessence stores, killed many magi and pulled the Order from its duties to Sleepers and to learning.
So fixed on revenge were the magi that when the Craftmasons took Mistridge, the Order made no answer and missed what the loss meant.
Some Hermetics now say the Order's tragic flaw is always fighting the wrong battle, and that it still burns with resentment at no longer being king.

title: House Flambeau after Doissetep
summary: The fire house in the years after the Reckoning.

claims.text: Since Doissetep fell and Porthos Fitz-Empress died, Flambeau mages have turned fatalistic and eager for one great strike against the Technocracy.
It is now the busiest house, drawing close to half of all Hermetic applicants, and its raids on Technocratic, Nephandic and other strongholds have risen fivefold.
Losses to weapons, Paradox, Quiet and the Cauls are mounting so fast that some fear the house will charge itself out of existence.

title: The Alchemists join the Order
summary: How the former Solificati became a Hermetic house.

claims.text: The Craft once called the Children of Knowledge, formerly the Solificati, startled everyone by accepting the Order of Hermes' offer and became its tenth house.
The Alchemists had hoped to win the Tenth Seat of Unity on their own, but saw little chance past the Celestial Chorus and the Verbena and chose a side before being left behind.
They bring both classic alchemy and newer schools into the Order, a strong position from which they hope to purify it from within.
